text:
Open with the outcome: LoadIx is the operating record that connects commercial intent, physical execution and financial preparation. Keep this to about 30 seconds before moving to the problem.

name: title-2
text: Fragmented tools break the operating story
textPreview: Fragmented tools break the operating story

name: problem-intro
text: When commercial rules, live execution and finance evidence live apart, every handoff creates another version of the truth.
textPreview: When commercial rules, live execution and finance evidence live apart, every handoff creates another version of the truth.

name: callout-body-2a
text: Routes, rates, quantities and tolerances need to remain connected to the work they govern.
textPreview: Routes, rates, quantities and tolerances need to remain connected to the work they govern.

name: callout-body-2b
text: Assignments, milestones, weights, documents and exceptions need one current operational record.
textPreview: Assignments, milestones, weights, documents and exceptions need one current operational record.

name: callout-body-2c
text: Revenue, cost and invoice preparation should start from approved trip facts—not reconstructed evidence.
textPreview: Revenue, cost and invoice preparation should start from approved trip facts—not reconstructed evidence.

text:
Frame this as the coordination problem LoadIx solves. Avoid claiming a quantified saving; the point is that the same load should not be reassembled across separate commercial, operational and finance records.

[Sources]
- Repository: docs/product-scope.md — product outcomes, personas and auditable end-to-end flow.

name: title-3
text: LoadIx keeps one record from contract to cash
textPreview: LoadIx keeps one record from contract to cash

name: workflow-intro
text: Rules are snapshotted into operational work, evidence follows the trip, and approved facts flow forward.
textPreview: Rules are snapshotted into operational work, evidence follows the trip, and approved facts flow forward.

text:
Walk left to right. Emphasize that trip snapshots protect operational history: later contract edits affect future work, not trips already generated. This is the bridge from the problem to the system.

[Sources]
- Repository: docs/product-scope.md — 13-step MVP business flow.
- Repository: docs/workflow-improvements.md — contract/load workflows and immutable route-specific weight snapshots.

name: title-4
text: Each role sees the work that matters
textPreview: Each role sees the work that matters

name: roles-intro
text: A shared record does not mean a shared screen. LoadIx presents the same facts through purpose-built workspaces.
textPreview: A shared record does not mean a shared screen. LoadIx presents the same facts through purpose-built workspaces.

name: callout-body-4a
text: Plan and assign trips, move work through legal states, monitor the live board and resolve exceptions.
textPreview: Plan and assign trips, move work through legal states, monitor the live board and resolve exceptions.

name: callout-body-4b
text: Use a touch-first PWA for next actions, weights, location updates and camera-friendly document capture—even with intermittent connectivity.
textPreview: Use a touch-first PWA for next actions, weights, location updates and camera-friendly document capture—even with intermittent connectivity.

name: callout-body-4c
text: Review reconciliation, charges, costs, estimated profitability, reports and invoice-preparation batches.
textPreview: Review reconciliation, charges, costs, estimated profitability, reports and invoice-preparation batches.

text:
Use this slide to orient the audience before the live demo login. Mention that permissions shape what each user can see and do; the demo can therefore move between operations, driver and finance perspectives without changing the underlying trip story.

[Sources]
- Repository: docs/product-scope.md — personas and primary needs.
- Repository: README.md and apps/loadix-web/src/router.tsx — current Operations, Driver, Finance, Reports and administration workspaces.

name: exceptions-intro
text: LoadIx keeps operational state, quantity evidence and review context together, so issues remain visible and explainable.
textPreview: LoadIx keeps operational state, quantity evidence and review context together, so issues remain visible and explainable.

name: callout-body-5a
text: The live operations board groups active trips by stage, exposes freshness and supports delayed or exception-only views.
textPreview: The live operations board groups active trips by stage, exposes freshness and supports delayed or exception-only views.

name: callout-body-5b
text: Route-specific weighing, explicit quantity sources and snapshotted tolerance rules make reconciliation reproducible.
textPreview: Route-specific weighing, explicit quantity sources and snapshotted tolerance rules make reconciliation reproducible.

name: callout-body-5c
text: Reasoned reviews and overrides preserve the actor, time and decision trail instead of hiding the exception.
textPreview: Reasoned reviews and overrides preserve the actor, time and decision trail instead of hiding the exception.

text:
This is a key demo promise: do not only show the happy path. Point out how stale positions, quantity sources, tolerance outcomes and reasoned overrides remain visible rather than being silently normalized.

[Sources]
- Repository: README.md — Operations control tower and trip lifecycle sections.
- Repository: docs/workflow-improvements.md — route-specific capture, tolerance outcomes and manual quantity controls.

name: title-6
text: Control is part of every workflow
textPreview: Control is part of every workflow

name: control-message
text: The system protects the record at the moment work happens—not as a clean-up exercise after the fact.
textPreview: The system protects the record at the moment work happens—not as a clean-up exercise after the fact.

name: control-1-title
text: Tenant-scoped access, server-side permissions and explicit support boundaries
textPreview: Tenant-scoped access, server-side permissions and explicit support boundaries

name: control-1-body
text: Optimistic concurrency prevents stale edits from silently overwriting newer decisions.
textPreview: Optimistic concurrency prevents stale edits from silently overwriting newer decisions.

name: control-2-title
text: Idempotent commands, immutable events and reasoned overrides
textPreview: Idempotent commands, immutable events and reasoned overrides

name: control-2-body
text: Retries produce one business outcome; sensitive operational and financial actions remain traceable.
textPreview: Retries produce one business outcome; sensitive operational and financial actions remain traceable.

text:
Keep this audience-facing. The architecture details matter because they change confidence in the demo: tenant identity is trusted from authentication, editable records reject stale versions, retry-prone commands are replay-safe, and material changes leave audit evidence.

[Sources]
- Repository: docs/product-scope.md — assurance, security/privacy and resilience requirements.
- Repository: docs/architecture.md — tenancy, authorization, concurrency, idempotency and audit design.

name: title-7
text: Finance starts with a trusted trip
textPreview: Finance starts with a trusted trip

name: finance-intro
text: Completed work moves forward only when its operational evidence and quantity outcome are ready for financial review.
textPreview: Completed work moves forward only when its operational evidence and quantity outcome are ready for financial review.

name: finance-body-1
text: Reconciled quantity, required documents and immutable rate snapshot
textPreview: Reconciled quantity, required documents and immutable rate snapshot

name: finance-body-2
text: Revenue, explicit costs, tax treatment and estimated profitability
textPreview: Revenue, explicit costs, tax treatment and estimated profitability

name: finance-body-3
text: Customer-grouped invoice batch with CSV/PDF handoff
textPreview: Customer-grouped invoice batch with CSV/PDF handoff

text:
Clarify the boundary: LoadIx prepares an approved and auditable invoice batch; it does not replace the accounting ledger. In the live demo, connect the completed trip to its rate snapshot, costs, approval and export-ready batch.

[Sources]
- Repository: docs/product-scope.md — finance preparation boundary and explicit MVP exclusions.
- Repository: README.md — financial calculation and invoice preparation endpoints and controls.

name: pilot-intro
text: The demo sits on the same domain model, permissions and infrastructure boundaries intended for the pilot path.
textPreview: The demo sits on the same domain model, permissions and infrastructure boundaries intended for the pilot path.

name: callout-body-8a
text: A modular monolith with a documented dedicated-server deployment path, database migrations and health checks.
textPreview: A modular monolith with a documented dedicated-server deployment path, database migrations and health checks.

name: callout-body-8b
text: Structured telemetry, durable background work, reporting queues, backups and rollback guidance support pilot operation.
textPreview: Structured telemetry, durable background work, reporting queues, backups and rollback guidance support pilot operation.

name: callout-body-8c
text: Versioned APIs and events, object storage, notifications and an edge-device/weighbridge foundation preserve clear boundaries.
textPreview: Versioned APIs and events, object storage, notifications and an edge-device/weighbridge foundation preserve clear boundaries.

name: pilot-demo-note
text: Deterministic synthetic data makes the demo repeatable without creating a separate fake product.
textPreview: Deterministic synthetic data makes the demo repeatable without creating a separate fake product.

text:
Use this as credibility, not an infrastructure deep dive. The important point is that the repeatable demo uses normal domain rules and a deterministic synthetic tenant; it is not a disconnected click-through prototype.

[Sources]
- Repository: docs/architecture.md — modular monolith and deterministic demonstration environment.
- Repository: docs/milestones.md — M16 security/governance, M17 reliability, M18 pilot deployment and M19 demonstration environment.
- Repository: README.md — dedicated-server pilot deployment and edge-device foundation.
